slides.title: Kirish: OIV/OITS va autopsiya

bullets.text: Markaziy asab tizimi (MNS) OITSda o‘pkadan keyin ikkinchi eng ko‘p zararlanadigan organ hisoblanadi.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

bullets.text: Autopsiya kasallikning tabiiy kechishini tushunish va klinik jihatdan aniqlanmagan infeksiya hamda xavfli o‘smalarni tanib olish uchun qimmatli usul.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

bullets.text: OIV autopsiyalarida neyropatologik topilmalarni baholaydigan tizimli tadqiqotlar kam uchraydi.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: Nega OITSda MNS ikkinchi o‘rinda zararlanadi deb hisoblanadi? Doskada: MNS va o‘pka zararlanishi tartibini yozing. Tipik xato: Autopsiyani faqat o‘lim sababini aniqlash usuli deb bilish.

slides.title: Bugungi mavzu uchun ikki tadqiqot

bullets.text: Braziliya tadqiqoti: 1989–2008 yillardagi 284 ta OITS autopsiyasida MNS o‘zgarishlari retrospektiv o‘rganilgan.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

bullets.text: Janubiy Afrika tadqiqoti: CD4 ≤150 hujayra/μL bo‘lgan kattalarda 34 ta minimal invaziv autopsiya (MIA) o‘tkazilgan.

source.author: Karat et al.
source.title: Autopsy Prevalence of Tuberculosis and Other Potentially Treatable Infections among Adults with Advanced HIV Enrolled in Out-Patient Care in South Africa, PLoS ONE

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 4 daq. Muhokama: Ikki tadqiqot dizayni qanday farq qiladi? Doskada: Ikki ustunli taqqoslash jadvali. Tipik xato: MIA va to‘liq autopsiyani bir xil deb hisoblash.

slides.title: MNSda opportunistik agentlar va o‘smalar

bullets.text: MNSda eng ko‘p uchraydigan opportunistik agentlar: Toxoplasma gondii, Cryptococcus neoformans va sitomegalovirus.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

bullets.text: O‘smalar orasida birlamchi non-Hodgkin limfomalari ustun turadi.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

bullets.text: OIVga xos o‘zgarishlar odatda kasallikning kechki bosqichida paydo bo‘ladi; ko‘p yadroli gigant hujayralar MNSda OIV infeksiyasi uchun «patognomonik» deb hisoblanadi.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: Nega OIVga xos o‘zgarishlar kechroq paydo bo‘ladi? Doskada: Uch agent nomini yozdiring. Tipik xato: Gigant hujayralarni har qanday MNS infeksiyasiga xos deb bilish.

slides.title: HAART davrida o‘zgarishlar

bullets.text: HAARTdan keyin opportunistik infeksiyalar kamaygan, OIV ensefaliti esa ko‘paygan.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

bullets.text: Dunyoning qolgan qismida OITS holatlarining 90% dan ortig‘ida bemorlar OIVning nevrologik asoratlari paydo bo‘lguncha yashamaydi.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

bullets.text: Rivojlanayotgan mamlakatlarda bunday autopsiya tadqiqotlari yanada kam, shu sababli neyropatologik o‘zgarishlarning haqiqiy tarqalishini aniqlash qiyin.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: HAART autopsiya manzarasini qanday o‘zgartirdi? Doskada: Oldin/keyin ikki ustun. Tipik xato: HAARTdan keyin MNS o‘zgarishlari butunlay yo‘qoladi deb o‘ylash.

slides.title: Joyga qarab farq: sil meningiti

bullets.text: OIV autopsiyalarida sil meningiti Hindistonda 12%, Afrikada 11% holatda kuzatilgan.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

slides.title: Autopsiyaning klinik-patomorfologik qiymati

bullets.text: Wilkes: 101 ta autopsiyada OITSga bog‘liq kasalliklarning 74% klinik jihatdan gumon qilinmagan.

source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

bullets.text: Gumon qilinmaganlar orasida: sitomegalovirus 49%, tizimli zamburug‘ 20%, Kaposi sarkomasi 14%, mikobakterioz 11%, MNS limfomasi 4%.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

bullets.text: Antinori: 1630 autopsiyada 297 ta invaziv zamburug‘ infeksiyasi topilgan; 54,2% klinik jihatdan gumon qilinmagan.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: Nega ko‘p kasallik hayotlik davrida aniqlanmaydi? Doskada: Foizlarni kamayish tartibida yozing. Tipik xato: Autopsiya natijasini klinik tashxisga qarshi qo‘yish.

slides.title: Braziliya tadqiqoti: maqsad va dizayn

bullets.text: Retrospektiv tadqiqot: OIV-musbat bemorlarning ketma-ket autopsiyalari (kamida 24 soat statsionarda bo‘lgan), Braziliya, Uberaba, 1989–2008.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

bullets.text: Maqsad: antiretrovirus terapiyaga qarab MNS o‘zgarishlarini tavsiflash, yashash davomiyligini baholash va muhim o‘zgarishlar klinik gumon qilinganini aniqlash.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

source.author: Silva et al.

slides.title: MNS gistologik namunalari standarti

bullets.text: Standart: kamida uch to‘qima bloki — turli bo‘laklardan (bir blok), bazal ganglionlar va gipokampdan (bir blok), o‘rta miya, ko‘prik va miyachadan (bir blok).

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

bullets.text: Parafin kesmalari 5 μm qalinlikda gematoksilin-eozin bilan bo‘yalgan.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

slides.title: Maxsus bo‘yashlar

bullets.text: Mikroorganizmlar va demielinizatsiyani baholash uchun maxsus bo‘yashlar qo‘llangan.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

slides.title: Immunogistokimyo va in situ gibridizatsiya

bullets.text: Ayrim hollarda polimer usulida monoklonal antitanalar qo‘llangan: toksoplazma, sitomegalovirus, gerpes virusi va JC virus uchun.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

bullets.text: Epstein—Barr virusi uchun in situ gibridizatsiya uch ta non-Hodgkin limfomasida o‘tkazilgan.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

slides.title: Antiretrovirus terapiya bo‘yicha guruhlar

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment

slides.title: Bemorlar xarakteristikasi

bullets.text: 284 tadan 80 tasi (28,2%) ayol; ayollar ulushi 17,8% (1989–1996) dan 33% (1997–2008) gacha oshgan.

source.author: Silva et al.
source.title: Neuropathology of AIDS: An Autopsy Review of 284 Cases from Brazil Comparing the Findings Pre- and Post-HAART (Highly Active Antiretroviral Therapy) and Pre- and Postmortem Correlation, AIDS Research and Treatment
